correctness.rationale: For finite abelian G and (v,k,λ)-difference set D with λ>0, orthogonality yields the exact correlation energy ∥E_D f∥₄⁴=Σ_g |A_g|² where A_0=S. Every nonzero difference fiber contains exactly λ ordered pairs, so |A_g|²≤λB_g, and Σ_(g!=0) B_g=S²−Q. Since Q≥S²/k, the optimal fourth-power coefficient is 1+λ(1−1/k)=1+(k−1)²/(v−1). The remainder is identically λ(Q−S²/k)+Σ_(g!=0)(λB_g−|A_g|²), all nonnegative; character restrictions saturate every summand and give the intrinsic equal-phase criterion. Checked exact rational signed weights for cyclic (7,4,2), lhs=rhs=119/4 in independent arithmetic, including λ-fiber verification. Boundary: the displayed parameter identity presumes v>1 and nontrivial difference set; trivial k=1, λ=0 admits C⁴=1 but value (k−1)²/(v−1) is well-defined when v>1; k=0 has undefined denominator and is not part of a meaningful difference-set L2 norm.
